minutes_text:
CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION MINUTES
  THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 27, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 9:00 AM

Robyn Gordon-Peterson, President  Gloria Cordero, Commissioner
Chief Coleman, Commissioner  Sharon Weissman, Commissioner

Omar Ramos, Interim Executive Director

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

CALL TO ORDER

At 9:11 AM, President Gordon-Peterson called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Coleman, Weissman, Gordon-Peterson

Commissioners Absent: Cordero

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Levi Sinkler, Acting Human Resources Officer, led the Pledge of Allegiance.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Dick Reed, IBEW47 Representative, spoke.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54458  Recommendation to consider a request from the Utilities Department for the
  classification specification division and consolidation of Senior Equipment Operator
  and Gas Construction Worker.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Coleman, seconded by President
  Gordon-Peterson, to approve recommendation, as amended, to rescind Civil
  Service Commission approval of the reversion request from Long Beach
  Utilities Department on September 11, 2024, and approve the consolidation of
  Senior Equipment Operator into Gas Construction Worker in the Gas
  Construction Division of the Long Beach Utilities Department retroactive to
  the original commission approval date of September 11, 2024, with
  consolidation and compensation as Gas Construction Worker effective
  September 21, 2024. The motion carried by the following vote:

There was no public comment.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Omar Ramos, Interim Executive Director, spoke.

President Gordon-Peterson spoke.

ADJOURNMENT

At 9:21 AM, there being no objection, President Gordon-Peterson declared the meeting adjourned.
